explanation: Wanless, 'Transversals in Latin Squares: A Survey' (2011), Conjecture 3.2: 'Each latin square of odd order has at least one transversal.' LatinSquare n is an n×n array over Fin n with injective rows and columns, and IsTransversal L σ (σ injective, symbols L i (σ i) distinct) is a transversal. The statement quantifies over all odd n and all L. Faithful.
